name: Psycho na Watashi o Yurushite yo!
original_name: サイコな私を許してよ！
source:
The heroines, they're all psychopaths!
If you don't fall in love with one of these psychopathic girls, you'll never leave the hospital...!
Yamai-kun, a college student who is a bit emotionally unstable, is locked in a hospital by chance. Will he be able to fall in love with a psycho girl and escape from the hospital?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16871]Freem![/url]]
translation:
女主角们都是神经病啊！
如果你不爱上这些精神变态的女孩之一，你就永远无法离开医院……！
情绪有些不稳定的大学生山井君偶然被关进了医院。他能爱上一个变态女孩并逃离医院吗？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16871]Freem![/url]]
